phrases.text: Pirate Shop Access doesn't come out of the chest like a weapon. Here's what actually happens.
When you open a chest, there's a small chance of a treasure prize.
It doesn't hit the floor. You get a message on screen telling you what you got.
So don't dig through the loot. Just keep opening chests!
Have you seen a treasure message yet?
Use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel.
Thank you for watching! Follow for more daily content.
